# #238 Training profile editing after onboarding
## Parent
#236
## What to build
A player can update their Training profile after onboarding: current goal, equipment access, injuries/limitations and weight. Edits that affect the program rebuild it after the player confirms. A coached player's edits are saved, but their program is never rebuilt, because the coach owns it. Proportions stay onboarding-only.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The profile update accepts current goal, equipment access, injuries/limitations and weight, with the same allowed values and ranges as the onboarding intake catalog, which stays the single source of truth. Proportions and other onboarding-only fields are refused. - [ ] Changing equipment access now rebuilds the program, alongside the existing injuries/limitations, weekly frequency and rep preference triggers. Goal and weight changes never rebuild. - [ ] For a coached player the edit is saved, no rebuild happens, and the response says a coach decides (the existing coach-controlled behaviour). - [ ] The Flutter app shows these fields for editing, pre-filled with the saved values. Before sending an edit that will rebuild, it asks for confirmation ("This rebuilds your program"). After a rebuild it refreshes the cached program. For a coached player it shows the coach-decides message instead. Saving offline shows the shared needs-connection message and changes nothing. - [ ] Tests: API tests for which fields rebuild (including equipment), coached-player behaviour and proportions refused; widget tests for the editor, the confirmation and the coached message.
